question: Compare prognostic genes in the HPA TCGA Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma and Lung Adenocarcinoma cohorts. Give favourable and unfavourable gene counts for each, same-direction and opposite-direction overlap counts, and the number of genes prognostic in both that are FDA approved drug targets or secreted to blood. Among genes favourable in both, rank twelve by the larger of their two favourable prognostic p-values, smallest first, ties by Ensembl ID. Give both p-values, the evidence categories, kidney and lung consensus nTPM and protein classes. Draw direction-overlap bars, a two-cancer p-value scatter and an RNA heatmap; provide the tables. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

turns.text: The prognosis filter doesn't return anything for the exact HPA cohort name I tested, so I'll try changing the naming to identify a query format that works.
The cancer-marker search gives gene lists but no p-values/directions. Let me probe which fields the lookup tools actually expose.

## Bottom line

I could not complete the full deliverable with the tools as they behaved during this session, so I am reporting exactly what I verified and explicitly declining the rest rather than estimating it.

## What I found when querying the cohorts

1. **Directional filter is non-functional for these cohorts.** `search_cancer_markers` with `prognostic = favorable` or `unfavorable` returned **empty** for every name form I tried: "Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma", "Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)", "kidney renal clear cell carcinoma", "Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma", "lung", and "Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)". Consequently, the **favourable/unfavourable gene counts per cohort and the same-direction / opposite-direction overlap counts cannot be determined** from the tools.
2. **The unfiltered cancer search returns no statistics.** `search_cancer_markers` omits p-values, prognostic direction, and expression values — it only returns gene identity, Ensembl ID, protein class, and evidence level. So the **two-cancer p-value scatter, the ranked top-12 by favourable-prognostic p-value, and any p-value-based table cannot be produced** from this tool.
3. **Per-gene pathology lookups do expose p-values and direction** (one gene family per call). The only per-cohort p-values I actually obtained are for the keratin-8 family in Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA):

| Gene | Ensembl | Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA) | Direction | p-value | KIRC entry |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| KRT80 | ENSG00000167767 | potential prognostic | unfavorable | 1.52e-5 | not reported |
| KRT81 | ENSG00000205426 | potential prognostic | unfavorable | 3.37e-4 | not reported |
| KRT8 | ENSG00000170421 | potential prognostic | unfavorable | 7.98e-5 | not reported |
| KRT86 | ENSG00000170442 | unprognostic | — | 6.28e-3 | not reported |

   Exhausive per-gene sweeps over the prognostic universes (hundreds to thousands of genes) are not feasible within the call budget, and no tool provides the cohort-wide per-gene (p-value, direction, nTPM) matrix in one call.

## Gene-list fragments retrieved (for reference, not ranked)

- **"Lung Adenocarcinoma" query** (truncated; 139 kB of rows): FGF7, NAPSA, NKX2-8, BRAF, SFTPB, KRAS, SFTPD, IREB2, IL2RA, TUSC3, ACRBP, NUS1, STRAP, AGR2, SFTPA1, MUC1, WNT11, GPX1, MUC21, SULF1, ANXA2, TLR7, HHIP, MME, MMP14, SFTPA2, STEAP1, FLCN, S100A4, plus NBPF paralogs and two rows keyed by Ensembl ID only (ENSG00000271254, ENSG00000286185, no protein class).
- **"Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma" query** (maxResults 10; returned 3 rows): CA12, ATF1, ENPEP. A broader "kidney"-keyword query returned a much larger set (UMOD, PKD1, PKD2, PAX8, REN, FLCN, ATP6V1B1, etc.), and the two naming forms could not be reconciled with the calls available to me.

## Items I am declining and why

- Favourable/unfavourable **counts per cohort**: directional filter returns empty; cannot determine.
- **Same-direction / opposite-direction overlap counts**: no directional sets available; cannot determine.
- **FDA-approved-target / blood-secreted subset among genes prognostic in both**: no per-gene prognostic membership beyond the four rows above; cannot determine (I can confirm, if the universe were known, that BRAF, KRAS, IL2RA, MME, TLR7, AVPR2, REN and ANXA2 carry the "FDA approved drug targets" class, and many list members carry "Plasma proteins", but that is not itself member-of-the-overlap evidence).
- **Top-12 ranked by the larger of the two favourable p-values (with p-values, evidence categories, nTPM, protein classes)**: only 2–3 favourable-related p-values are obtainable per gene individually, and the universe of jointly prognostic genes was never established. **Eligible members returned: 0; I state the count rather than filling twelve slots.**
- **Direction-overlap bars, two-cancer p-value scatter, RNA heatmap**: no per-gene paired (p_KIRC, p_LUAD) or nTPM matrix exists in the tool outputs; I will not draw charts from absent data.
